dct_description_sm: This data set contains one hundred and twenty-six (126) files (.tif, .prj, .twf) that create an orthomosaic image of the Frank Slide Interpretation Centre. The data was collected with a DJI Phantom 4 Pro and processed with Pix4D Mapper 4.5.6 by Geomatics Engineering students at the School of Construction, Southern Alberta Institute of Technology, 2020-06-05. This data set also contains a readme file (.txt) to assist with the unpacking of the .tar file.
